description: What a catalog verdict must bind to count as governed acceptance (adversarial audit R2). Judged by requirements-compiler catalog-acceptance inside the governed Verification gate; a builder-run verdict is supporting evidence only.

faultSensitivity.rationale: A round trip that passes whatever the content is verifies nothing (SA-07). These checks are the catalog's real persistence obligations (INV-017, INV-023..038 save/reload/isolation); the frozen plan has no such category, so the gate no longer passes the inert --require-fault-sensitive content-round-trip to the plan judgement.

factsDecision: ODR-R10-04: Rehearsal 010 offers no domain or profile selection on the start screen, so INV-003 is not applicable. A candidate may not declare a different value; an owner decision changes it.
